manualCases.perActor: Earliest valid run for each baseline/A/B/C. Inspect the first decision diverging from the earliest valid baseline executed path at a same displayed frame; if unavailable, earliest revisit after other-screen exploration; if unavailable, first screen with at least2visibleclickcontrols or initial input. Invalid prefixes reviewed separately and never substituted for complete behavior evidence.
manualCases.additional: First remaining distinct same-image different-choice pair across actors and first within-actor divergent repeated run, at most6cases/12current-nextPNGrefs total. If no same-image candidate bindings match, report unmatched context rather than force comparisons.
manualCases.selection: No selection by objective success or by whether a stereotyped persona behavior appears. Keep missing comparisons explicit.

consistency.facts: Observed frames/actions/quotes and short reason category only.
consistency.interpretation: Relate visible situation to supplied knowledge/expectation/constraint as a fallible interpretation; reasons are not internal cognition.
consistency.limits: These are case-level reviewer interpretations, not calibrated scores or automatic mandatory-tendency checks. No contradiction inferred merely from novice acting quickly or cautious user omitting a confirmation.

inference: Within/between distance and exact blocked-label tail are exploratory. Statistical reference assumptions unvalidated, invalid complete-block exclusions disclosed, no naturalness/goal/human ranking.

preExecutionSourceUpdate.reason: Independent P1 audit-invalid trajectory exclusion repaired; case selection and metrics unchanged.
